@@ -232,6 +237,9 @@ mod SelfhostChecker do
   # against the scrutinee's type (a variable pattern binds it); the case's type is the
   # LUB-join of the arm bodies (Rian.Check; ADR-0059).
   pub def infer_env(CCase(scrut, arms), env) := branch_join(arm_pairs(arms, infer_env(scrut, env), env))
+  # a list literal infers `Vec(T)` when its elements — and any cons tail — LUB-join to
+  # a concrete element type `T`; else `unknown` (Rian.Check; ADR-0059).
+  pub def infer_env(CList(elems, tail), env) := list_ty(join_all(infer_all(elems, env)), list_elem(infer_tail(tail, env)))
 
   # a bound name's type from the env, else `unknown` (the checker does not guess).

@@ -438,4 +446,44 @@ mod SelfhostChecker do
   def tvar([c]) := c >= 65 and c <= 90
   def tvar([c, d]) := c >= 65 and c <= 90 and d >= 48 and d <= 57
   def tvar(_) := false
+
+  # ── list inference helpers (Rian.Check) ──
+  def infer_all(Vec(Core), Dict(String, String)) Vec(String)
+  def infer_all([], _) := []
+  def infer_all([e | rest], env) := [infer_env(e, env) | infer_all(rest, env)]
+
+  def infer_tail(Tail, Dict(String, String)) String
+  def infer_tail(TClose, _) := "unknown"
+  def infer_tail(TCons(e), env) := infer_env(e, env)
+
+  # the element type the list type carries: `Vec(T)` -> `T`; anything else -> unknown.
+  def list_elem(t String) String := le(Prim.str_chars(t))
+
+  def le(Vec(Int53)) String
+  def le(['V', 'e', 'c', '(' | rest]) := Prim.str_from_chars(trim_rparens(rest))
+  def le(_) := "unknown"
+
+  # the list type for a concrete element; an `unknown` element yields `unknown`.
+  def list_ty(elem_t String, tail_elem String) String
+  def list_ty(elem_t, tail_elem)
+    if tail_elem == "unknown" or tail_elem == elem_t do
+      list_of(conservative(elem_t))
+    else
+      "unknown"
+    end
+  end
+
+  def list_of(t String) String := if t == "unknown" do "unknown" else "Vec(" <> t <> ")" end
+
+  # drop ALL trailing `)` (mirrors String.trim_trailing(rest, ")")) — reverse, skip
+  # leading `)`, reverse back.
+  def trim_rparens(cs Vec(Int53)) Vec(Int53) := rev(skip_rparen(rev(cs, [])), [])
+
+  def rev(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Int53)
+  def rev([], acc) := acc
+  def rev([c | rest], acc) := rev(rest, [c | acc])
+
+  def skip_rparen(Vec(Int53)) Vec(Int53)
+  def skip_rparen([41 | rest]) := skip_rparen(rest)
+  def skip_rparen(cs) := cs
 end
